basis: No edits to inherited active contract bytes

c1_review.rationale: ElementEquipment owns versioned player root and per-Hero active four slots/levels and disjoint bound-backup map. Row ID, I5 item ID, Hero partner ID and template first ID remain distinct. No Element instance ID is invented.

Consume one qualified I5 Element stack only when first binding; unload/replacement retain prior item and level as inactive backup; reactivation transfers from backup without a second debit. A template occurs at most once in a Hero active+backup union; the same inventory template can independently bind to different Heroes using different actual stock.

Slot1 Core/SPCore; slots2..4 Normal. SPCore requires genuine Character OriginTableID match. Enhance bound active or backup item one level, cap10, with exact current-level source cost. Destroy one owned backpack item at level0 or one active/backup item at actual level, refund exact source rows through I5 once.
